senses.gloss:
m. (-पः)
The name of a king and ancestor^1 of RĀMA.
E.
दिली said to be the barbarous name of Hastināpura or the modern Dehli, and प who protects or rules.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-राट्)
King DILĪPA: see the preceding.
E.
दिलीप as above, and राज् a king.
